coverage: Complete supplied ClinGen gene–disease validity CSV rows with gene, HGNC, MONDO and curation identities. Includes limited, disputed and refuted classifications as well as stronger evidence. Gene context only; no personal disease or allele inference.
privacy: Fixed public source snapshot only. No user-file, personal identifier, or genotype query.

assetCompression.verification: Every input SQLite hash and every fully inflated output hash match the original manifest; encoded hashes recorded separately.
